description: Use this when the user asks how to structure a Reel, TikTok, Short, YouTube video, carousel, caption, content plan, offer or ad, or how a platform's algorithm, hashtags or profile setup work. Call it before writing so the answer follows formats that performed. Returns a short summary of each matching video format, storytelling or retention principle, hook family, paid-ad framework or platform fact. Free; no sign-in. Describe the goal in plain English with platform and format. Do not use for hook templates (use xcut_find_hooks).

goal.description: What is being made or decided, in English, with platform and format. e.g. 'instagram carousel that gets saved', 'tutorial reel structure', 'how many hashtags on instagram'
goal.title: Goal

kind.description: Optional: structure (formats), principle, hook_type, ad_framework or platform_fact.
kind.title: Kind
